title: The Testing Gap — FrontDeskReview evidence-ledger coverage census
scope: What a zero means here: our corpus is reviews harvested from 55 whitelisted, text-fetchable outlets. Labs that render only in JavaScript (RTINGS, for example) and paywalled reviews are systematically absent — our pipeline drops what it cannot verify. A product with nothing on record here may well have been tested somewhere we can't index. These numbers measure our evidence ledger, not the world.
